evidence.title: What is REST?: REST API Tutorial

name: REST API Tutorial
summary: Tutorial site on REST: architecture constraints, HTTP methods, JSON and API design, with guides, how-tos and FAQs.
description: Articles by Lokesh Gupta explaining REST and how to build RESTful APIs: the six architectural constraints, resource naming, HTTP methods and status codes, caching, HATEOAS, versioning, security, rate limiting and pagination. Organised into a REST tutorial, JSON guides, how-tos, FAQs and reference sections.
contains: guides: architectural constraints, resource naming, HTTP methods, caching, HATEOAS, versioning
topics: security, rate limiting, pagination, performance, large payloads
sections: REST, JSON, how-tos, FAQs, references
